assumptions: preserved failure is required after every reduction
minimality is scoped to the registered reducer/test semantics
1-minimal is not globally minimum unless proven
minimized conditions do not by themselves identify causal mechanism
falsifier: Failure-condition minimization does not reduce downstream diagnostic/search cost versus classic delta debugging/model-based parent, changes the failure identity, overstates 1-minimality as global minimum, or turns correlation/minimality into causal authority.
minimal_counterexamples: reduced case no longer reproduces same failure
1-minimal subset is far from globally minimum
failure requires interaction of two conditions so single-condition localization fails
nonmonotone test causes naive binary reduction error
minimized circumstances change after context/version update
delta debugging already matches Orion operator at lower overhead
small minimized set is mistaken for causal diagnosis
novelty_residual: Integration of exact failure-condition minimization into Orion residual/failure memory with content-bound scope and downstream diagnosis/constraint-learning handoff, beyond classic delta debugging if a residual remains.
object_description: Systematically minimize the conditions/input/configuration that preserve an exact registered failure before broader diagnosis or verified conflict compilation, while distinguishing minimal failure context from causal explanation.
oracle_or_lower_bound: On small known worlds exhaustively enumerate condition subsets to compute the globally minimum failure-preserving set. Compare ddmin/Orion outputs to this oracle; in larger worlds claim only the exact registered minimality notion achieved.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped failure-context minimization/search-cost result only; no causal/mechanistic or scientific authority.
qoi: Paired reduction in failure-context size and downstream verified diagnostic/search cost versus classic delta debugging and model-based diagnosis parents, with exact failure reproduction and minimality semantics.
same_system_ablation: Same failure worlds with no minimization, classic ddmin, model-based diagnosis directly, and Orion minimization+downstream diagnosis.
scope: deterministic or explicitly handled flaky failure oracle

strongest_parents.justification: Canonical algorithm for simplifying and isolating failure-inducing circumstances; must be treated as a strong parent, not rediscovered.
Structural diagnosis parent tests whether explicit system models localize the fault without a separate minimization phase.
Small known worlds provide exact global-minimum comparison and expose the distinction from 1-minimality.
